metadata.title: Linearity of Graph Manifold Groups
metadata.abstract: We complete the proof that every compact 3-manifold group is linear. Specifically, we construct a faithful representation in GL5(Q[u]) for a finite-index subgroup of every closed non-geometric graph-manifold group.
